hero.title: We take your operation off the spreadsheet and the notebook.
hero.lede: We are four developers. We build management systems, websites and apps for businesses that need to organize what today lives on paper, in WhatsApp and in Excel. Seven systems delivered in 2026.

projects.title: Seven systems running, in seven different sectors.
projects.lede: Every line started with someone running the operation on paper. Open one to see the before, what we built and the result.

granjatech.what: Automation: production, real-time sensors, batches and inputs
granjatech.before: Batch, input and production control in notebooks and spreadsheets, with no real-time sensor readings.
granjatech.built: Automation platform with production control, real-time sensor monitoring and batch and input management.
granjatech.resultNote: Needs a real number from the project — batches under control, hours saved or losses avoided.

barberflow.before: Paper agenda and appointments booked over WhatsApp.
barberflow.built: Full management and online booking, with no double-booking.

agronutri.before: A spreadsheet for feed calculations, rebuilt for every batch.
agronutri.built: Precise feed calculation and diet formulation, to cut costs and keep the herd healthy.

hotelos.before: A reservations notebook and billing kept separately.
hotelos.built: A complete PMS: reservations, billing and day-to-day operations in one place.

controleImoveis.what: Billing and tax amounts per property
controleImoveis.before: A billing and tax spreadsheet per property.
controleImoveis.built: Web system for tracking billing and tax amounts.

vendasEstoque.name: Sales & inventory
vendasEstoque.what: Sales and inventory control for a fruit pulp factory
vendasEstoque.before: Stock and orders jotted down in a spreadsheet.
vendasEstoque.built: Sales and inventory control system for a fruit pulp factory.

scrapingCnpj.name: CNPJ scraping
scrapingCnpj.what: API-based collection, database and Excel, JSON and CSV export
scrapingCnpj.before: Manual lookups, one company at a time.
scrapingCnpj.built: API-based collection with database storage and export to Excel, JSON and CSV.

items.text: “Pessoal da 404Devs, parabéns pelo sistema! Ficou perfeito. O ponto alto para mim foi ter tido essa visão de bastidores durante as etapas; isso faz toda a diferença para quem está do lado do cliente. Acompanhar a construção de perto me deu total confiança no que estava sendo entregue. Obrigado pela parceria e pelo trabalho nota 10!”
items.translation: Translation: “Congratulations to the 404Devs team on the system! It turned out perfect. The highlight for me was getting that behind-the-scenes view at every stage; it makes all the difference when you're on the client's side. Following the build up close gave me total confidence in what was being delivered. Thank you for the partnership and the top-notch work!”
items.meta: Study planning and goals dashboard · Mar 2026 · ★ 5.0

items.text: “Fiquei muito satisfeito com a landing page produzida. O visual é limpo e as informações estão bem organizadas, o que ajuda muito na hora de convencer meus clientes a fecharem negócios. O site abre rápido no celular e no computador, o que era uma prioridade para mim. Um investimento que valeu muito a pena! Parabéns a toda equipe do 404Devs.”
items.translation: Translation: “I'm very happy with the landing page. The look is clean and the information is well organized, which really helps when I need to convince my customers to close a deal. The site loads fast on both phone and desktop, which was a priority for me. An investment that was well worth it! Congratulations to the whole 404Devs team.”

services.title: What we solve.
services.stack: We work with C# / .NET · Node.js · TypeScript · React · React Native · PostgreSQL · MySQL · MongoDB · Supabase · Docker · Azure

items.title: Custom management system
items.text: For anyone running the operation on spreadsheets, notebooks or WhatsApp who has outgrown them. Scheduling, inventory, customers, billing and reports in one place.

items.title: Websites and landing pages that sell
items.text: Fast, clear pages built for your customer to close the deal — not to win a design award.

items.title: Integration and automation
items.text: Connecting systems that don't talk to each other and automating the manual work someone does by hand, over and over.

items.title: Maintenance and evolution
items.text: Ongoing support after launch, from the people who built the system — not from a help desk that has never seen your code.

process.title: You follow the build from start to finish.
process.lede: “The highlight for me was getting that behind-the-scenes view at every stage.” — client, March 2026 (translated from Portuguese)

steps.title: Discovery and alignment
steps.text: We map goals, business rules and expectations to define the scope through direct communication.
steps.deliverable: A scope document with features, timeline and a fixed price

steps.title: Architecture and development
steps.text: We build the front end, back end and database with the right stack for the project, prioritizing performance and maintainability.
steps.deliverable: Previews of the work in progress, so you can follow along closely

steps.title: Validation and launch
steps.text: We test the critical flows, tune the queries and ship with stability and security.
steps.deliverable: The system live, plus training for your team

steps.title: Follow-up and support
steps.text: We stay on with technical support, incremental improvements and monitoring to keep the system running smoothly day to day.
steps.deliverable: A direct channel for fixes and improvements

terms.title: Everything in writing, before we start.
terms.lede: You know exactly what you'll get, when, for how much — and what happens if something goes wrong afterwards.
